purpose: VECTOR-mu is a projection-layer operator. Its execution surface is a documented bounded dot projection with typed refusals; it is not a metadata copy, and it commits nothing.

operation.formula: points[k] = clamp( sum_i v_i * x[k*d + i] / ||v|| , -B , +B )
inputs: observation stream x (length n, n % d == 0)
optional descriptor supplying the declared trailing width
operation.descriptor_only_rule: a TensorSubstrate carries no values, so descriptor-only projection returns no result rather than a shaped copy

refusal_rules.no_projection_vector: v is empty, or its norm is not positive
refusal_rules.dimension_mismatch: the descriptor declares a trailing width that differs from d
refusal_rules.invalid_bound: W * C is not finite and positive

VMU1.name: projection_computes_values
VMU1.check: points equal the bounded dot product of v and each observation window

VMU2.name: projection_is_bounded
VMU2.check: every point lies in [-B, +B] and clipping is counted

VMU3.name: refusal_is_typed
VMU3.check: every unusable input maps to exactly one declared status

VMU4.name: projection_commits_nothing
VMU4.check: id, verb, W, C and v are unchanged after projecting
